prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / sprite production. Generate an ACTUAL TRANSPARENT PNG ANIMATION SOURCE for the specified approved character, not a concept board or collage. Image1 is approved master (use ONLY specified row), image2 is the SAME character's new front-facing animation source to lock identity/equipment/colors, image3 is an approved previous production atlas for pixel technique. Match design exactly, but independently DRAW the required different facing; do not mirror or rotate front art.
Exactly16 separate complete authored poses in FOUR ROWS x FOUR COLUMNS, evenly spaced invisible grid, preferred square1536x1536. No text, grid, labels, swatches, inset, floor or ground shadow. TRUE transparent alpha background, not checkerboard. All equipment/effects inside cell with generous transparent gutter and full canvas margins. One consistent detailed chibi wuxia pixel character per cell; same body size, armor, weapon, horn count, palette in every pose. Crisp square clusters and thin stepped dark outlines, restrained3–4 shade material clusters, upper-left light, no blurred glow/painted gradients. Stable elevated orthographic top-down three-quarter overworld camera, visible top planes of shoulders/head/feet, never flat side-scroller or isometric. Same design as approved concept, no variation/alternative.
ROW1: cols1–2 idle A/B with subtle authored breath/cloth movement; cols3–4 hit recoil A/B, visibly flinch then recover.
ROW2: four distinct walking keyposes: left-foot advance, passing, right-foot advance, passing opposite, alternating legs/arms, equipment stable. No sliding static copies.
ROW3: four attack keyposes in order described below, anticipation/contact/recovery.
ROW4: four death keyposes in order described below.
All16 DIFFERENT authored drawings, not translated, scaled or rotated duplicates. Retain one facing for all frames including attacks; do not turn toward side. No detached VFX or projectile.
CHARACTER: Wave20 Ma Vương Tiên Phong. Exact row20: massive compact humanoid demonic warrior, TWO large swept-back crimson/dark horns, black/crimson plated armor with muted DARK GOLD trim and guard, angular gold-edged faceplate with red eyes, broad arms and plated boots, short crimson waist tabs, no long cape. ONE very heavy two-handed Chinese broad warblade with dark iron rectangular spine, chipped silver edge, crimson inner vein and ornate dark-gold guard. No bull head/hooves, axe, halberd or boss crown. Aura only tiny red attached sparks at shoulders/boots; character remains readable.
ALL16 POSES FACE LEFT / facing SCREEN-LEFT. Nose, gaze, feet and weapon action point LEFT. Same ELEVATED side/three-quarter overworld view, visible top of shoulders/head and some front chest. Do not face right. The concept LEFT depiction is the direction reference.
ATTACK: massive two-handed warblade attack: lift the ONE broad blade high while leaning back; commit two-handed forward/downward cleave; lowest heavy impact/follow-through pose with both hands on grip; recover to strong guard. Same blade shape, never duplicate weapon or limbs. No detached ground shockwave.
DEATH: dramatic heavy collapse: armor cracks with tiny connected crimson sparks and knees bend; body drops onto one knee with blade lowered; body falls onto side with the same horns/helmet; final fully fallen broad armored body, blade beside both hands and faint attached red aura fading. No gore or dismemberment.
EQUIPMENT CONTINUITY: retain exactly same weapon in idle, all walking steps, recoil and death. Never drop/omit/switch weapon hand during walk or hurt. Full body AND weapon inside every cell, at least8% cell gutter to prevent clipping. No extra limbs/duplicate staves. Details simplify into clean pixel clusters, no noisy edge halo.
